items.name: Caddoc's Lantern Charm
items.lore: A dented lantern's last glass, set in brass. Carried somewhere, as Caddoc would have liked.

items.name: Hale Family Signet
items.lore: Maren Hale's father's ring, meant for her brother.

items.name: Tombwalker's Girdle
items.lore: Taken from the Tomb of Mithra, where Caddoc Hale went singing.

items.name: Mantle of the Kind Lie
items.lore: Maren keeps his supper warm. Some kindnesses weigh more than truth.

items.name: Weaver's Hopeful Mantle
items.lore: Woven by Ysolde Marchant the night her son came home.

items.name: Three-Note Band
items.lore: Silver, cold, and humming three notes no one sings any more.

items.name: Waystone Bracer
items.lore: Cut from the north road's waystone, where the pilgrims' boot-prints ended.

items.name: Shepherd's Lucky Charm
items.lore: An old shepherd's charm. He said you'd need it more than him.

items.name: Sheep-Song Sash
items.lore: Woven with the shepherd's tune - the sheep still follow it.

items.name: Bell-Wether's Favour
items.lore: A faerie promise in silver. Faeries keep their promises better than most people.

items.name: Shepherd's Crook-Pin
items.lore: A brass pin shaped like a crook. Ada's late husband wore it.

items.name: Fleece-Lined Bracer
items.lore: Soft inside, tough outside. Cotswold makes them for its own.

items.name: Mill-Wheel Ring
items.lore: Forged from a broken pin of Bran's wheel.

items.name: River-Reed Sash
items.lore: Woven by the sprites. It smells faintly of the river.

items.name: Sickle-Hook Belt
items.lore: A harvester's belt with a hook for the sickle. Tobias insists.

items.name: Brownie's Button
items.lore: A wooden button with a face carved on it. It winks sometimes.

items.name: Reeve's Tally Ring
items.lore: Notched for every sheaf. Tobias counts everything.

items.name: Anthill Amber Charm
items.lore: A bead of amber from the dragon ants' mound. There's a tiny ant inside.

items.name: Ploughman's Mantle
items.lore: Heavy brown wool. Gronyr's family has worn it for generations.

items.name: Snare-Wire Bracer
items.lore: Twisted from the poachers' own wire.

items.name: Forester's Acorn
items.lore: A brass acorn. Odo hands them out to anyone who helps.

items.name: Purse-Snatcher's Ring
items.lore: Taken back from a cutpurse. It's had several owners, none of them honest.

items.name: Tithe-Bearer's Belt
items.lore: The tithe purse hung from it all the way to Camelot. Now it's yours.

items.name: Red-Seal Signet
items.lore: The red seal, filed flat. It doesn't stain your finger any more. Much.

items.name: Thaumaturge's Charm
items.lore: A hedge-wizard's charm. It smells of burnt feathers.

items.name: Watchman's Bracer
items.lore: Issued at Prydwen Keep. It's never been polished, which is how you know it's been used.

items.name: Old Fort Keystone
items.lore: A chip of the old fort's keystone. Elidyr kept the rest for the new gate.

items.name: Red-Handed Gauntlet-Ring
items.lore: Gamwell's ring. He earned the name honestly, at least.

items.name: Prydwen Cloak
items.lore: Watch blue, with Arthur's ship Prydwen stitched in silver at the shoulder.

items.name: Huntsman's Horn-Charm
items.lore: A little horn of yellowed bone. Blow it and dogs prick up their ears a mile off.

items.name: Hound-Leash Belt
items.lore: Plaited leather, chewed at one end.

items.name: Twrch Trwyth Tusk
items.lore: A sliver of the great boar's tusk, kept by the Difwych for twenty years.

items.name: Round Table Ribbon
items.lore: A strip of blue from Sir Bedwyr's surcoat. He tore it off himself.

items.name: Last Hunt Mantle
items.lore: Boar-hide, trimmed with the brothers' colours.

items.name: Acolyte's Red Cord
items.lore: A red silk cord, knotted thirteen times. Idris burned the knots out.

items.name: Barrow-Blessed Ring
items.lore: Brother Idris blessed it on the barrow fields. It's warm.

items.name: Rite-Stone Shard
items.lore: A shard of one of the rite stones. It's quiet now.

items.name: Gravedigger's Girdle
items.lore: Brother Idris's spare. He's been digging a lot of graves again.

items.name: Barrow-Field Bracer
items.lore: Bronze, very old, found in a broken barrow.

items.name: Tomb-Warden's Key
items.lore: An iron key on a chain. It opens nothing any more.

items.name: Lady Enid's Favour
items.lore: A blue ribbon, given to those who serve the realm well.

items.name: Crimson-Bane Ring
items.lore: Cut from the warden's own signet. The red key's been scratched out.

items.name: Mithras-Stone Mantle
items.lore: Dark red, Roman-cut, taken from the tomb. Idris blessed it twice to be sure.

items.name: Brimstone Charm
items.lore: A lump of yellow stone from Darkness Falls' mouth. It never quite cools.

items.name: Barwick's Spare Gauntlet-Ring
items.lore: Sir Barwick had it made from his old gauntlet. 'Not Berwick,' it says inside.

items.name: Doorward's Belt
items.lore: Worn by those who've held Darkness Falls' door.

items.name: Filidh Song-Torc
items.lore: A thin gold torc. It hums the same three notes, over and over.

items.name: Oak-Leaf Mantle
items.lore: Green wool, stitched with oak leaves. The filidh's colour.

items.name: Merlin's Riddle-Ring
items.lore: Engraved inside: 'Where the thorn grows, the threads meet.'

items.name: Cronker's Knuckle
items.lore: Big as your fist. Hollis wanted it as proof.

items.name: Bridge-Toll Belt
items.lore: Hung with the coins Cronker took from travellers. Hollis returned the rest.
